HtmlDescription:

Features Include:

  • Spark arrested silencer
  • Meets U.S. Forest Service standards
  • Internal metal baffle, chambers, and sound absorbing materials for a muffled sound
  • Constructed of aluminum and stainless steel
  • Double-walled mounting bracket(s)
  • Longer canister design keeps noise levels to a minimum
  • No loss of motor performance
